title: Aggrega Wasm Host-Function Error Codes
description: The closed set of machine-matchable error codes the host sets on a host-function reply envelope when a callback fails, beside the human-readable message. The code is a stable, machine-matchable identity a guest branches on without parsing the message text; the message stays free-form prose for humans. This schema is the single source of the code vocabulary shared across every host-function reply envelope (source-pack, source-file, parse-source, and fetch-external-input): each envelope carries an optional error_code string set on failure and absent on success. A guest tolerates an absent code (older host: fall back to the message) and an unrecognized code (newer host emits a code this guest predates: treat as no specific identity, fall back to the message).

code.description: The machine-matchable failure identity, in lowercase-snake wire tokens. fetch_request_unreadable: the fetch-external-input URL could not be read from guest memory. fetch_input_unavailable: no external-input service is bound in this context. fetch_failed: the external-input fetch failed. request_unreadable: the request payload could not be read from guest memory. request_undecodable: the request payload could not be decoded. source_root_unavailable: no source root is bound in this context. source_read_failed: a file, directory, or subtree under the source root could not be read. unknown_selection_op: the pack selection named an operation the host does not recognize. source_escape: the resolved path escaped above the source root and was rejected. producer_consumption_reentry: a producer-consumption callback was denied because it re-entered beyond the permitted depth. no_source_parser: no source parser is bound in this context. no_parser_for_format: no parser is registered for the requested format. parse_failed: the resolved parser failed to parse the source.
